title: Smoke test: full playable round, fix obvious bugs
description: Play 5+ complete games as the human, verify rule correctness. Have the AI win and lose. No console errors. No frozen states.
acceptance_criteria: A non-developer could sit down, understand the screen, and finish a game.

title: Build Player abstraction with Hand, plus simple AI policy
description: IPlayer interface + HumanPlayer + AIPlayer. AI policy: defend if possible (lowest valid card), otherwise eat. Attack with lowest non-trump if available. Greedy but legal.
close_reason: IPlayerController + HumanPlayer (no-op, UI drives input) + AIPlayer (greedy: cheapest legal play, prefer non-trump). GameLoop wires controllers to engine via OnTurnBegan event. Smoke test 50/50 games complete with 0 stalls — found and fixed an infinite-loop bug in greedy logic when defender's hand size capped attacks. Engine is correct.

title: Implement game-state machine and rules engine (no UI)
description: States: Setup, Dealing, AwaitingAttack, AwaitingDefense, ResolvingBout, Drawing, GameOver. Pure C# (testable). Implement: trump determination, lowest-trump-goes-first, can-attack, can-defend (higher same suit OR trump), bout resolution (defender eats vs cards discarded), draw-to-min, win condition (last with cards = Fool).
acceptance_criteria: Console smoke test plays a full game between two stub AI players with no UI.
close_reason: GameEngine.cs implements full state machine: Setup/Attack/Defense/Resolving/GameOver. Bout.cs tracks attack/defense pairs. Rules.cs is the single source of truth for Beats/CanAttack/CanDefend. Engine emits events (OnTurnBegan, OnAttackPlayed, OnDefensePlayed, OnBoutResolved, OnDrew, OnGameOver) for UI/AI. Trump = bottom card of deck (visible). Lowest-trump-goes-first. Draw order attacker-then-defender. Win = empty hand when deck empty; Fool = last with cards. Editor menu Wits and Fools/Smoke Test/* runs greedy-AI vs greedy-AI without UI. Compile clean (0 errors).

title: Define core data model: Card, Suit, Rank, Deck, CardData ScriptableObject
description: 36-card deck (6-A, 4 suits). Pure data classes + a CardData SO for any per-card art/metadata override. No MonoBehaviours yet — runtime-only model first.
close_reason: Implemented as pure C# (no MonoBehaviour): Suit enum + glyphs, Rank enum (6-A) + labels, Card readonly struct with equality, Deck with seeded shuffle (36 cards, trump at bottom), Hand. Skipped CardData ScriptableObject — not needed for MVP since cards are just (Suit,Rank) pairs and visuals derive from sprite lookup. SO can be added later if abilities need per-card data.

title: Wipe old Scripts/, scenes, and stale prefabs
description: Delete /Assets/Scripts/Core/, /Demo/, /Cards/, /Debug/, CubeMover.cs. Delete duplicate Assets/Assets/GameScene.unity. Reset GameScene.unity / SampleScene.unity to a clean Main scene. Keep Settings/, TutorialInfo/, Textures/, InputSystem_Actions/.
notes: Per audit: every script fights every other script. Clean slate.
close_reason: Deleted all old Scripts/{Core,Demo,Cards,Debug}, three GameScene copies, duplicate Assets/Assets dir, stale Prefabs/Data/TutorialInfo, uv artifacts. Created fresh empty GameScene.unity at Assets/Scenes. Created Scripts/Runtime/. Unity console: 0 errors after refresh.

title: Rebuild Wits and Fools prototype from scratch
description: Old prototype is unsalvageable per audit (36+ fixer scripts patching incomplete core systems, claimed phases didn't actually work). Rebuilding clean: 2-player vs AI, core Durak rules, NO special abilities, polished programmer-art visuals.
acceptance_criteria: Playable from start to finish: deal hands, attack, defend, eat-or-discard, draw to refill, win condition. Smooth animations, readable UI, 2-player vs AI.

title: Scene wiring + GameManager bootstrap
description: Single GameScene. GameManager MonoBehaviour bootstraps the rules engine, wires UI references, runs the game loop. No singletons-from-Awake — explicit init order from one entry point.

title: HUD/UI: turn indicator, deck count, trump display, win/lose screen
description: Header band shows whose turn + phase ('You attack', 'AI defends'). Show remaining deck count. Trump suit icon + card visible. End-of-game modal: 'You won' or 'You are the Fool'. Restart button.
close_reason: HudView wires turn label, deck count, trump, end-bout button, game-over panel + restart. GameManager keeps all four updated on each engine event. Disabled-button alpha bumped from 0.4 to 1.0 (with darker color) for visibility.

title: Card animations: deal, attack, defend, eat, discard, draw
description: Use coroutines or Unity DOTween (add via Package Manager if not present). Each game action has a visible motion. Keep durations short (~0.25s) so play feels snappy.
close_reason: Implemented as part of GameManager: dealing visuals (instant on setup), attack/defense/eat moves use coroutine-based ease-out-cubic to bout slots, eat absorbs visuals back into hand, discard moves cards to discard slot then destroys them. No DOTween dependency needed. ~0.22s per move per design (snappy).

title: Input + interaction: click/drag-to-play, valid-target highlighting
description: On player turn: hover highlights valid plays. Click a card to attack OR defend the leftmost undefended attacker. Disabled-state visuals for invalid plays. End-bout button when human is attacker and decides not to add more.
notes: Discovered/fixed runtime bugs during interactive testing: (1) HandLayout.Apply() crashed on destroyed CardViews after BeginNewGame because GameManager.ClearAllVisuals didn't tell HandLayout to drop references — added defensive null skip in Apply + use HandLayout.Clear() in ClearAllVisuals. (2) GameLoop pumped synchronously on engine events causing AI to act before visuals updated — refactored to deferred Tick called from GameManager.Update with AiThinkSeconds delay.

title: Table layout: hand fan, opponent hand (face-down), deck, trump, discard, attack/defense slots
description: Top-down 'table' layout per GDD. Player hand bottom (fan), opponent hand top (face-down stack). Center: deck stack with trump card sticking out from under it, discard pile, and bout slots (attacks top row, defenses overlapping below). Use Canvas + Layout Groups with manual positioning where the auto-layout fights us.
close_reason: Built TableView, HandLayout, HudView. SceneBuilder editor menu reproducibly builds the entire scene: Camera, EventSystem, Canvas with felt+frame, HUD bar, deck stack, trump slot, discard slot, bout area, two HandLayouts, end-bout button, game-over panel, GameManager. Game runs in play mode (verified via screenshot). Issue found: TMP Essential Resources never imported in this project — fixed in PrefabBuilder/SceneBuilder by detecting missing font and importing automatically.

title: Card prefab + visual rendering (face up/down, suit, rank)
description: Single Card prefab with Image background, suit pip, rank text, optional art slot. UI Toolkit OR uGUI — pick one (uGUI is fine for MVP). Card knows how to render from CardData. Programmer-art quality but readable from a real player viewpoint.
close_reason: CardView MonoBehaviour: face/back, suit pip, rank top-left + bottom-right (rotated), highlight states (none/playable/disabled + hover), click events. PrefabBuilder editor menu builds CardView.prefab procedurally — repeatable, no manual hand-tweaking. 110x160px, programmer-art with TMP text, red/black suit colors, dark-red back with W&F label.

title: Triage and delete root-level Python/AI artifacts not needed for prototype
description: Audit each root-level .py, .md, .json, .sh and generated_images/, apple_variants/, transparent_output/. Delete what's not needed. ComfyUI scripts may be worth keeping in /tools/ if the user later wants AI-generated art.
close_reason: Deleted 8 old prototype docs and 4 Claude-Code-router files. Moved ComfyUI toolchain (15 .py files + 6 dirs, ~70MB) to tools/comfyui/. Project root now contains only Unity project files + AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md/README.md + the GDD + dev plan. .csproj files already gitignored.

title: Update WitsAndFools_Development_Plan.md to reflect the rebuild
description: Replace the old phase-by-phase doc with: brief MVP scope, what's done, what's intentionally cut for prototype (special abilities, multiplayer, art, audio). Future-work section.

value: unity-mcp bridge (com.unity.ai.assistant relay) drops when Unity does a domain reload (Play mode entry while compiling, or RunCommand crashes inside Unity). Doesn't auto-recover; requires /mcp reload in Claude Code. Workaround: wait for compile to fully finish before pressing Play. Time penalty per drop: ~30 seconds + user interaction.

Wits&Fools: GameLoop initially Pumped() synchronously inside OnAttackPlayed handler, which caused AI to act before GameManager's visual handler ran (subscriber order). Refactored to GameLoop.Tick() called per-frame from GameManager.Update; AI ticks delayed by AiThinkSeconds for deliberate pacing. Avoids re-entering engine inside its own events.
